headline: Governors Reject PS Oluga's Directive On County Hospital Paybills
seoTitle: Governors Reject PS Oluga SHA Paybill Directive
metaDescription: The Council of Governors has instructed county hospitals to disregard a directive from PS Oluga regarding the removal of Social Health Authority paybills.
aiSummaryBullets: The Council of Governors issued instructions for county hospitals to ignore a directive by PS Oluga.
The directive mandated the removal of specific hospital paybill numbers associated with the Social Health Authority.
Governors expressed formal opposition to the administrative order issued by the Principal Secretary.
aiContextParagraph: The Council of Governors has formally contested a directive issued by Principal Secretary Oluga, which sought to remove existing hospital paybill numbers related to the Social Health Authority. In response to the order, the Council instructed all county-run medical facilities to continue utilizing their current payment platforms. This dispute centers on the administrative management of healthcare funds following the implementation of the Social Health Authority. The disagreement reflects ongoing tensions between national government officials and county leadership regarding the operational control of public health infrastructure and revenue collection systems. While the Principal Secretary has pushed for the consolidation of payment mechanisms, governors maintain that current practices are essential for the effective operation of facilities within their respective jurisdictions. This development highlights the challenges of coordinating healthcare policy and financial administration across devolved government structures in Kenya.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent outlets, reflecting active disagreement between regional leadership and national government officials.
